concept.title: Review task header
concept.shortdesc: The review task header stays available while you work in a task and shows task details, status information, and actions such as sharing, viewing owner details, and requesting re-review.

conbody.p: When a review task is open, the upper part of the header stripe remains available no matter which page you open inside the task. This keeps the main navigation options and the breadcrumb available at all times.

fig.title: Review Task Header Stripe (Independent Review Task)

section.title: Header details
section.p: The lower part of the header changes depending on the page context and your role in the task. It can show the task name, the review status, the task owners, the number of reviewers who have finalized the task, and the due date, if a due date is configured in the Task Settings page. You can click More Details to see additional information such as the creation time and the current branch for project review tasks.

section.title: Header actions
section.p: The header can include a workflow action button next to the review status. The available action depends on your role and the current task state. For example, task owners can see actions such as Close review, Reopen review, or, for project tasks, Start integration. Reviewers can see Finalize my review. For details, see Review Task States and Status.
If you are a task owner, you can click Share to configure access to the task.
You can click the Owners area to see information about the task owners.

section.title: Finalized widget
section.p: You can click the Finalized widget to see the status for each assigned reviewer.

section.title: Request re-review
section.p: If at least a task reviewer Finalized their review, the task owner can use the Request re-review button to reset the finalized status for all reviewers and changes their status to In progress. If the task owner reopens a closed task, the finalized status is also reset for all reviewers.

Users who are assigned to the task but have not yet accessed it are labeled as Pending in the Review Status Summary pop-up window. This helps task owners identify users who have not yet responded to the review request.

section.title: Changed files only filter
section.p: When a reviewer opens a task after the owner requested another review, the Task Files page includes a Changed files only filter. This makes it easier to identify the files that changed and need another review.
